question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH user_ages AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    CAST(TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE) AS DATE) AS bd,
    CAST(TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE) AS DATE) AS birth_date_cast
  FROM mst_users
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'Others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(birth_date_cast)) AS age
  FROM user_ages
) sub
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category
